payload.title: Punta Cana Destination Wedding Guide
payload.excerpt: Plan a Punta Cana destination wedding with legal steps from official sources, the drier months, long-haul guest travel and questions for your venue.
key_takeaways: You can marry legally through a Dominican civil registry office, or marry at home and hold a symbolic ceremony in Punta Cana.
Dominican civil weddings for foreigners need apostilled documents with Spanish translations, so the paperwork sets your lead time.
February and March are the drier months, while the Atlantic hurricane season runs from 1 June to 30 November.
Ask any resort about other weddings that day, beach ceremony rules, shade, access and a covered wet weather option before you sign.

faq.q: Are you legally married if you get married in the Dominican Republic?
faq.a: Yes, if the marriage is performed through a Dominican civil registry office under Dominican law, which assists marriages between two foreigners. Australia generally recognises an overseas marriage that was valid where it took place and would have been valid here, though it cannot be registered in Australia. General information as at November 2026, not legal advice.

faq.q: Can we have a symbolic ceremony in Punta Cana and marry legally at home?
faq.a: Yes. You marry legally in Australia with a celebrant, then hold a symbolic ceremony in Punta Cana without the Dominican civil process. It gives you full control of the ceremony's timing and wording.

faq.q: When should we hold a wedding in Punta Cana?
faq.a: On the WMO's 1961 to 1990 climate normals for Punta Cana, supplied by ONAMET, February and March are the driest months. October is the wettest month. Weigh the weather against your guests' school holidays and leave, then hold your date.

faq.q: When is hurricane season in Punta Cana?
faq.a: The US National Hurricane Center gives the Atlantic hurricane season as 1 June to 30 November. As at November 2026, Smartraveller notes that tropical storms and hurricanes can happen in other months, so a covered option and good travel insurance matter in any month.

faq.q: What do Australian guests need to enter the Dominican Republic?
faq.a: As at November 2026, guests buy a tourist card on arrival and complete the electronic entry and exit form. Rules can change at short notice, so they should check with the nearest Dominican embassy or consulate before booking.

faq.q: Do Punta Cana resorts offer wedding packages?
faq.a: This guide doesn't quote package prices, because resort wedding offers differ so much in what they include, from ceremony set-up to the number of events and guests covered. Compare them line by line, ask what happens to the space if another wedding is booked that day, and get every inclusion in writing. For what sits behind a package price, read [how resort wedding packages are priced](/destination-weddings/all-inclusive-wedding-cost).

cta.subtext: When you are ready to shape a date around your guests' travel, start with Wedded Concierge.
